items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-01
items.q: Or do you go as Richard B. Or Arbinian? Anyway. I go all the different kind of ways.

ctx.x: All right, we're started. What's today's date? First of August, 1970 and 8. 1970 and where are we? We are still, since this is a continuation, at 4140 Sena Drive, Las Cruces, New Mexico, zip code 88001. S-I-N-N-E-R? S-S-E-N-N-A. Okay. I never thought about that before. Sent a laxative, as a matter of fact. Spelled the same way? Same plan. Oh, this is named after a poem. Yeah. All these streets along here are named after a poem. On Mission Bell, yeah. Well, that's a new street in a different subdivision. I see.…
Okay, the lead has gone through.
